links.outcome: LLM clinical accuracy and guideline adherence on women's health scenarios, including outdated guidelines and unsafe omissions
links.effect: No model mean performance exceeded 75 percent; best model reached 72.1 percent. Top models showed low fully correct rates and substantial variation in harm rates.
links.quote: Across 3,102 attempted responses (3,100 scored), no model mean performance exceeds 75 percent; the best model reaches 72.1 percent.

links.outcome: Dosing errors in LLM responses to women's health scenarios
links.effect: Benchmark designed to expose dosing errors; no model exceeded 75% mean, and harm rates varied substantially. Dosing-specific rates are not reported in the provided text.
links.quote: We present the Women's Health Benchmark (WHBench), a targeted evaluation suite of 47 expert-crafted scenarios across 10 women's health topics, designed to expose clinically meaningful failure modes including outdated guidelines, unsafe omissions, dosing errors, and equity-related blind spots.

unlisted_practices: Women's-health-specific expert-crafted benchmark with safety-weighted rubric scoring and server-side score recalculation

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline clinical accuracy, safety, and failure modes of multiple LLMs on a women's health benchmark (WHBench) using an expert rubric, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
